name: Inkscape
tagline: Professional vector graphics editor for illustration and typography
description: Inkscape is a professional quality vector graphics software which runs on Linux. It is used by design professionals and hobbyists worldwide for creating a wide variety of graphics such as illustrations, icons, logos, diagrams, maps, and web graphics.
features: Advanced Bézier curve and node editing tools
Flexible text tool with kerning, letter spacing, and line spacing
Broad format export (PDF, EPS, SVG, PNG, WebP)
